method: Baseline reconstructed by reading exact HEAD sources; current routes inspected in source and exercised by mocked Playwright operator-person-flow (4/4 PASS on build i-Z4wWSwFuZxvT2ZwWjZ-). Counts distinguish data entry from navigation/control actions. No baseline browser build was started and no user timing study was performed.
scope: Only the named controlled scenarios; photo and PDF acceptance evidence is tracked separately by parent agents.

scenarios.name: Create one PERSON with FIO, position, WORKER category and one PS direction, starting from the new-request form; exclude optional KZ, dates, photo and director flow

actions: choose PS in request training actions
category Next with existing WORKER default

scenarios.interpretation: Progressive disclosure adds three explicit transitions. The benefit verified here is one main action per stage, absence of the mass table and direct resumption from saved data; this does not prove fewer total clicks.

scenarios.name: Edit both PS period endpoints on an already filled PERSON whose first course is PS

actions: expand Period of training, protocol and validity

scenarios.interpretation: The period is visible inside the course without an additional dates accordion. Both versions already share linked form edits, so no invented reduction in repeated date entry is claimed.

scenarios.name: COMPANY with N ordinary special-ITR recipients whose employer comes from the request company

baseline.repeatedEmployerControlsInRows: 2*N for BIN and RU address, plus workplace only when missing or explicitly overridden

current.exceptionHandling: A preserved explicit employer exception has one compact notice and one addressed edit action.

scenarios.interpretation: The common company was already an inheritance source. The current change removes repeated row controls; it does not claim the old workflow required entering the company N times.

scenarios.name: COMPANY shared PS period for multiple people, measured after course assignment

baseline.individualDetailsPeriodPairs: one per PS document when expanded

scenarios.interpretation: Mock browser regression changes the common period and proves previously manual individual periods remain unchanged.

baselineSources: apps/web/components/recipient-details.tsx documents default tab and document-date-details
limits: Not a timing, conversion or human usability study.
The full E2E run and final-build browser acceptance are reported separately; this comparison is not their replacement.
Counts apply only to the explicitly described starting state and do not include optional details or approval.
